consumption_stockout_adjusted.label: Consumption adjusted for stock-outs
consumption_stockout_adjusted.detail: reported consumption ÷ (1 − days out of stock ÷ days in the period): what would have been used had stock been there
consumption_stockout_adjusted.needs: a consumption figure and days out of stock for the same period

population_based.label: From population
population_based.detail: catchment population × the country's annual rate per 1,000 for the product
population_based.needs: a catchment population and a per-1,000 rate in the country pack

peer_median.label: Median of similar facilities
peer_median.detail: the median of facilities of the same type in this dataset with an observed figure
peer_median.needs: at least five facilities of the same type with observed demand for the product

service_based.label: From consultations
service_based.detail: consultations × units per consultation from the country pack
service_based.needs: a consultation count and a per-consultation rate in the country pack
